title: Evidence-to-Impact Accelerator Cohort 2026
benefit: Catalytic Seed Grant + 10-Stage Lab Prototyping + Demo Day
summary: Join our flagship 10-stage accelerator taking community-driven ideas from Discover & Diagnose to Policy, Finance, and Continental Scale.
description: Selected teams receive equity-free capital, human-centered design sprints, systems diagnosis mentorship, and direct access to African institutional and investor networks.
eligibility: African innovators aged 18–35 with community-rooted problem statements in climate, agri-food, health, education, or civic delivery.

title: Continental Policy Innovation Challenge 2026
summary: Design evidence-based policy solutions to Africa's most pressing challenges across AI, climate adaptation, and youth employment.
description: Participants move through: Research → Diagnosis → Policy proposal → Prototype → Policy pitch, culminating at Policy Innovation Demo Day.
eligibility: Young researchers, economists, lawyers, and civic technologists aged 20–32 residing in Africa.

title: 2026 African Youth Policy & Futures Fellowship
benefit: $12,000 Living Stipend + AU & Ministerial Desk Placement
summary: Join 40 high-performing young policy researchers formulating legislative briefs and 2030/2050 futures scenarios across Africa.
description: Fellows receive intensive training in predictive policy analytics, participatory governance, and direct placement with ministerial and African Union advisory councils.
eligibility: African nationals aged 21–32 with background in public policy, economics, law, sociology, or STEM.

title: CivicTech Seed Innovation Grant 2026
summary: Catalytic funding and prototyping support for young African founders building tech solutions that enhance civic delivery, climate resilience, or public service access.
description: Selected startups enter our 6-month venture lab with access to user testing labs, government data sandboxes, and follow-on investor syndicates.
eligibility: Teams with majority founders aged 18–35 possessing a functioning MVP in AgriTech, CleanTech, GovTech, or HealthTech.

title: Graduate Employability Bootcamp & Simulation
benefit: Full Scholarship + Verified Professional Portfolio + Employer Matching
summary: Mandatory experiential learning transitioning youth from Education → Employability → Employment through full workplace simulations.
description: Participants complete end-to-end recruitment challenges: job analysis, CV customization, ATS mastery, psychometric tests, case interviews, and salary negotiation.
eligibility: African university students in final year or recent graduates within 3 years of completion.

title: Call for Papers: Africa 2050 Futures Series
benefit: $1,500 Honorarium per Accepted Paper + Open-Access Indexing
summary: Inviting empirical research manuscripts examining 'Africa's Youth Workforce in 2050: Four Possible Futures' across AI, work, and demographic shifts.
description: Selected papers will be published in AfriYouth's flagship policy publication and presented at the 2027 Africa Youth Foresight Summit in Addis Ababa.
eligibility: Primary authors under 35 affiliated with an African research institution, university, think tank, or independent research collective.
